notes.title: Update 2.01
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Update 2.01 is now available on Steam and will be available on iOS, Google Play, Amazon and Windows Phone in a few days. Apple will have to wait for the review time, but shouldn't take more than a week.

The update fixes a lot of the bugs from 2.0, and should also improve performance. Hopefully levels with a lot of moving objects won't lag as much :)

The update also includes a stat recount system that will recount all stars, demons and collected user coins. There was a bug in 2.0 that gave users extra stars/coins, this fixes and resets that problem.

The stat recount will also remove stars gained from cheats/bugs/exploits. So if you lose stats when the update comes out, you will know why
smile emoticon

Hopefully the system should be more stable now and the leaderboards should slowly become more cheat-free :)

New mappacks are in the works and should be done in a few days!

Thanks everyone for your awesome support! I will upload the first update 2.1 promo in a day or two :D

/RubRub

- The stat recount will also remove stars gained from cheats/bugs/exploits.

notes.title: Update 2.0 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://boomlings.com/images/20screen3.png[/img]

Could it be?...

Finally! Update 2.0 is the BIGGEST update ever for Geometry Dash! It will be releasing on all platforms and should be available within a few hours. Amazon/Windows Phone may take a little longer.

- New level "Geometrical Dominator"
- New Demon level "Deadlocked"
- Robot gamemode
- Moving objects
- Teleportation portals
- User coin system
- User profile pages
- Friend and messaging systems
- Friend leaderboards
- Over 50 new achievements and rewards
- Lots and lots of new art
- Animated monsters and level objects
- Drastically improved save and load times
- Editor preview mode
- Lots of editor improvements
- Unlimited color channels
- Lots of bug fixes
- Secrets...
- and more!

Thank you for playing Geometry Dash! Since this is a very big update, there are probably a few sneaky bugs that I have missed. Please contact support@robtopgames.com for help with any issues.

/RubRub

tags.feature: - Lots and lots of new art
- Drastically improved save and load times
